title: Fletcher Henderson's brilliant sound from hard keys
summary: Henderson wrote in remote keys like F-sharp and C-sharp, which gave the band its crisp sound.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: dug it, you know. I mean, I dug -- and I like the way Fletcher wrote because Fletcher used to get brilliant sounds from the clarinets and things. But why he did that, I later on learned, see, he wrote in them hard keys that people don't play in, you know, like he'd write a song in F-sharp, C-sharp.
Yeah, and G-sharp. And Hawk and them was playing them solos in this key, in C-sharp and in G-sharp.
They'd learn them solos and they was playing in those keys. Nobody could play like that and that's why the band sounds so brilliant and crisp.
